content.text:
rmdir: failed to remove '/opt/elasticsearch': Directory not empty
chown: cannot access '/opt/elasticsearch/config/elasticsearch.yml': No such file or directory

observation.command:
rm /opt/es && rmdir /opt/elasticsearch && mv /opt/downloads/elasticsearch-7.17.28 /opt/elasticsearch && chown -R elastic:elastic /opt/elasticsearch && ln -sfn /opt/elasticsearch /opt/es && ls /opt/elasticsearch/bin/elasticsearch && cat > /opt/elasticsearch/config/elasticsearch.yml <<'EOF'
cluster.name: index-data-explorer
node.name: node-1
path.data: /opt/elasticsearch/data
path.logs: /opt/elasticsearch/logs
network.host: 127.0.0.1
http.port: 9200
discovery.type: single-node
EOF
chown elastic:elastic /opt/elasticsearch/config/elasticsearch.yml && echo CONFIG_OK
